narrative.overview: Evidence-first warehouse operations UI: dark forest shell, warm document surfaces, restrained terracotta structure, and explicit semantic verdicts.

rules.name: Evidence before verdict
rules.body: Keep observations and PO expectations visible next to the decision.

dos: Use semantic labels with every verdict
Use mono text for identifiers and measurements
donts: Do not imply mock observations came from photos
Do not use ornamental gradients or nested card stacks
